name: Astra
desc: Astra is an Etrean NPC. They are the clerk at the weapons shop in [Etris](location:etris). While weapons can be found and purchased around the shop, they sell them directly. They do not sell _all_ of the weapons found around the shop, however.
additional_info: -   For a brief period, Astra's name was changed to Armorer before being renamed back to Astra.
